title: Dashboard metrics real-time update
description: Verify that the dashboard displays real-time updated metrics, trends, and client status correctly.

steps.description: Authenticate as a valid user and navigate to the dashboard.
Verify that the metrics widgets display current data reflecting real-time status.
Simulate changes in client status and data updates on the backend.
Verify that the dashboard updates metrics and graphs within 2 seconds to reflect the changes.
Verify that dynamic client status indicators update accordingly.

title: Client CRUD operations
description: Verify full Create, Read, Update, and Delete operations on client entities with proper data handling and UI feedback.

steps.description: Log in as an administrator and access the client management interface.
Create a new client with valid data and save.
Verify the client is listed with correct details and confirmation message is shown.
View client details, including payment history.
Verify that all client information including payment history is displayed accurately.
Update the client information and save changes.
Verify the updated client details persist and UI reflects the change.
Delete the client record.
Verify client is removed from the list and deletion confirmation is shown.
Attempt to create a client with missing required fields.
Verify validation errors prevent creation and appropriate error messages display.

title: Trial user creation and conversion
description: Ensure that trial users can be created automatically and converted to active clients properly.

steps.description: Trigger chatbot to create a new trial user.
Verify that the trial user is created with correct trial period and is listed in the system.
Monitor the trial period countdown and test system handling of trial expiration.
Verify system notifies user of trial status and disables trial functions upon expiration.
Convert the trial user to an active client using the conversion feature.
Verify that trial user record is updated to active client status and all related data migrates correctly.

title: IPTV Server configuration and health monitoring
description: Validate CRUD operations and real-time health monitoring of IPTV servers including API integrations.

steps.description: Access server management panel and create a new IPTV server configuration with URL and settings.
Verify the new server is saved and appears in the server list.
Edit existing server configuration and save changes.
Verify changes persist correctly.
Simulate server status changes and errors via API integration.
Verify real-time monitoring dashboard updates health status and alerts appropriately.
Delete a server configuration.
Verify server is removed and no longer monitored.

title: Multi-channel notifications with dynamic templates
description: Verify notifications are correctly sent via WhatsApp, Email, and Push channels using dynamic templates and automations.

steps.description: Trigger manual notification send with predefined dynamic template to a user via WhatsApp.
Verify user receives correct WhatsApp notification with expected dynamic content.
Trigger email notification send via automation rule.
Verify accurate email content, correct template variables, and proper delivery.
Trigger push notification to user's device.
Verify push notification is received timely and content is accurate.
Test notification failure scenarios such as invalid contact or delivery failure.
Verify errors are logged, retries attempted as configured, and user/admin alerted appropriately.

title: Security policies and compliance enforcement
description: Test enforcement of security policies including MFA, RLS, audit logging, and GDPR/LGPD compliance.

steps.description: Log in as user with MFA enabled; validate that MFA prompt appears and blocks access without verification.
Verify MFA verification succeeds and grants access.
Access datasets with RLS policies configured for different user roles.
Verify users can only access data they are permitted to as per RLS policies.
Perform sensitive operations and verify audit logs are generated with correct details.
Verify audit trail accuracy including user, time, operation, and affected data.
Test data privacy features to verify GDPR/LGPD compliance such as consent handling and data anonymization.
Verify compliance features work correctly and data protections are enforced.

title: Application performance and intelligent cache validation
description: Validate application performance with cache active and automatic cache invalidation working correctly.

steps.description: Load various application pages, including dashboard and client management, under normal and peak load conditions.
Verify page load times are below 2 seconds consistently.
Modify underlying data and monitor cache invalidation and reflected UI changes.
Verify cache is invalidated automatically and data displayed is fresh and correct.
Evaluate multi-layer cache system behavior with simulated cache hits and misses.
Verify cache levels interact correctly and optimize data retrieval efficiently.

title: Automation workflow orchestration
description: Test system workflows and automation processes for trigger, execution, failure handling and proper completion.

steps.description: Define and enable a sample automation workflow involving notifications and client status updates.
Trigger workflow via system event or manual initiation.
Verify all workflow steps execute in correct sequence and with expected outcomes.
Simulate failure in one workflow step.
Verify workflow error handling activates, logs error, retries if configured, or fails gracefully.

title: IPTV server backup and recovery
description: Validate backup process for IPTV server configurations and ability to recover data from backup.

steps.description: Trigger automated backup process manually and scheduled.
Verify backup files are created with expected completeness and metadata.
Simulate data loss or corruption in server configurations.
Perform data recovery using backup.
Verify restored data matches last backup state accurately and system stability is maintained.

title: Login and authentication error handling
description: Ensure authentication system handles correct and incorrect login attempts securely with proper feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to login page and input valid username/email and password.
Submit login form.
Verify login is successful and user redirected appropriately.
Attempt login with invalid username/email.
Submit login form.
Verify login failed and appropriate error message is displayed.
Attempt login with valid username but incorrect password.
Submit login form.
Verify login failed and error message indicates invalid credentials without revealing sensitive info.
Attempt login with empty credentials.
Verify validation errors are shown for required fields.
